abstract:
We study two-generator affine shells and positive integer cycles of the shortcut Collatz map using maximal odd runs followed by even runs. The shifted fixed point of each valley block has $2$-adic valuation equal to its odd-run length. Fixed points are globally injective, distinct blocks do not commute, and fixed points vary monotonically along each ray. On permutation shells, the Young-diagram formula identifies the first parity divergence with a $2$-adic valuation, gives collision-free second moments, and separates one-particle relocations by an explicit Diophantine bound.

Excursion recombination forces fourth-moment growth above the square of the shell size. On a single ray, additive collisions correspond exactly to hard-rod start-site multiplicities. For rods of lengths one and two, a six-state transfer matrix yields strictly faster growth than the excursion family at every interior density. Off-ray carry collisions first occur at lengths $9$ and $11$ for two pairs, and between $13$ and $18$ for a third pair.

Using the contracting descent and height factor of earlier polymer work, we charge height amplification only to expanding stretches. Exact certificates exclude alternating cycles through $46$ stretches and arbitrary-order cycles with $1\le M_+\le21$ expanding stretches and $0\le M_-\le21$ contracting stretches of odd-run length at least two. With no imposed upper bound on $M_-$, any fixed expanding-stretch count gives effective finiteness and five or fewer expanding stretches are excluded. Bi-adic macro-group minima and finite rational controls distinguish local integer realizability from rational cycle closure.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: The revision credits cassian_mahler's collatz_142 v1 and compares Theorem 3 and Propositions 6.1, 6.2 and 6.4 directly with the valley decomposition. It credits the inherited sharp roof, strict descent, block-length-free finiteness and polymer-count exclusion, and keeps the Rhin roof calculation as an alternative verification. It removes the subsumed general M <= 20 claim and centers the manuscript on fixed-point valuation, affine-shell additive energy and off-ray carry thresholds. The revised cycle analysis counts height amplification only on expanding stretches. It certifies alternating M <= 46 and arbitrary-order 1 <= M_plus <= 21 and 0 <= M_minus <= 21 by separate monotonicity in both counts. It proves effective finiteness and M_plus <= 5 exclusion with no imposed upper bound on M_minus, using exact continued fractions and the Rhin tail. Figure 1 now plots the exclusion ratios and credits the earlier roof. The collatz_192 Section 8b replay and collatz_188 Section 6 zero-slack examples are identified as finite controls, with the asymptotic sub-cubic argument attributed to unpublished notes. The manuscript distinguishes the excursion dynamic program from exhaustive quadruple counts and describes the carry checks as exhaustive short-horizon counts and exact verification of explicit witnesses. The checker now supports --manuscript-path, validates the revised metadata and makes the standalone audit scope explicit. The supplement and clean-room verification were rebuilt for the new certificate.
title: Metabelian Affine-Shell Additive Energy, Off-Ray Carry Thresholds, and Expanding-Stretch Cycle Decoupling for the Collatz Map
